Rødovre is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, published by the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Improvement Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, functioning as a crucial instrument for local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. 

Specifically, Rødovre's data concerning stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients is incorporated into the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation therapy [^src1]. The municipality's specific performance metrics and patient counts are detailed in the report's comprehensive breakdown of regional and municipal data [^src1]. Because the available corpus only mentions Rødovre in this single tabular context, no further historical or relational details are available.
